{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = sales['revenue'] == 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[qa_mask]
print(f'QA orders removed: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Exclude QA orders and refunded orders from analysis
# Only completed orders without QA status are valid
valid_orders = sales[(~qa_mask) & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute total revenue by channel
total_revenue_by_channel = valid_orders.groupby('channel')['revenue'].sum()
print(total_revenue_by_channel)"}
